# Culinary Template Tasks & Outline

## Section Breakdown (1:1 Fidelity with ColorLib accordion-02)

1. **Header / Navbar**: Logo, nav links (Home, Menu, About, Reservation, Contact), mobile menu toggle.
2. **Hero Section**: Large atmospheric banner with restaurant tagline ("Delicious Food & Wonderful Experience"), CTA button.
3. **Interactive Menu Accordion**: Category tabs / accordion panels (Breakfast, Starters, Main Dishes, Desserts, Drinks) with item cards (image, title, description, price tag).
4. **About / Chef Story**: Dual-column layout with chef/kitchen imagery and narrative text about fresh ingredients.
5. **Special Offers / Highlights**: Grid highlighting chef specials or seasonal dishes.
6. **Footer**: Contact info, opening hours, social links, and mandatory Component Dock attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Implementation Notes

- Use Lucide icons for UI controls and navigation.
- Ensure smooth accordion toggle behavior with accessible ARIA attributes (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`).
- Color palette: Warm amber (`#c59b27`), dark neutral `#1a1a1a`, light cream `#fcf8f2`.
